{{Top|leg}}
A '''low-frequency transmitter''' was a communications device. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] employed a low-frequency transmitter at the [[Mortex Sector HQ]] on [[Fangol]] to communicate with the [[Fangol's artificial moon|artificial moon]] in geosynchronous [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] with the base. Due to Fangol's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], communications and [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] would not penetrate from the surface installation, necessitating the moon to handle the such tasks.
